items.criterion: Access Microsoft Careers and attempt search for an Applied Scientist role in Redmond, WA
items.description: Agent navigates on Microsoft Careers (careers.microsoft.com) and attempts to search for an "Applied Scientist" position with location set to (or queried as) Redmond, Washington. Full credit if the agent performs the search and reaches a results set or relevant job page, OR if the site is inaccessible (e.g., outage/CAPTCHA/login wall) and the agent clearly reports the blocker without fabricating results. Partial credit if the agent uses Microsoft Careers but the Redmond, WA filter/query is not clearly applied or confirmed.

items.criterion: Open one relevant listing (Applied Scientist; Redmond, WA if available) and use it as the extraction source
items.description: Agent opens a single job listing that is Applied Scientist and confirms Redmond, Washington location when such a listing is available in results. If no Applied Scientist listing explicitly in Redmond, WA is available, full credit if the agent clearly states this and opens the closest available alternative that preserves primary intent (Applied Scientist in the greater Redmond/Seattle area or listed as Redmond campus) while clearly noting the mismatch/ambiguity. Partial credit if the listing is Applied Scientist but location is not checked or is ambiguous. No credit if the opened listing is clearly not Applied Scientist when Applied Scientist listings are available.

items.criterion: Report the job number from the opened listing
items.description: Agent accurately records and reports the job number/ID shown on the opened Microsoft Careers listing. Full credit for correct job number. If the listing page does not display a job number, full credit if the agent explicitly states that the job number is not visible on the page viewed (without inventing one). Partial credit if an incomplete/ambiguous identifier is reported but is clearly tied to the listing.

items.criterion: Report the work-site arrangement from the opened listing
items.description: Agent accurately reports the work-site arrangement stated on the listing (e.g., on-site, hybrid, remote, telework, or a percentage work-from-home statement). Full credit for the exact arrangement as shown or a faithful paraphrase. If the listing does not state a work-site arrangement, full credit if the agent clearly reports that it is not specified on the listing page viewed.

items.criterion: Extract two key responsibilities from the opened listing
items.description: Agent provides two distinct responsibilities/duties explicitly stated in the job description (or clearly labeled responsibilities section). Full credit if two distinct responsibilities are correctly captured. If the listing does not clearly enumerate responsibilities, partial credit for accurately summarizing two concrete duty statements from the narrative text; full credit only if the agent clearly indicates the page lacks an explicit responsibilities section and quotes/paraphrases accurately from available text. No credit if responsibilities are fabricated or not supported by the listing.

items.criterion: Extract two preferred qualifications from the opened listing
items.description: Agent provides two preferred qualifications explicitly labeled as preferred (or clearly distinguished from required/minimum) on the listing. Full credit if two distinct preferred qualifications are correctly captured. If the listing does not include a preferred qualifications section or does not distinguish preferred vs. required, full credit if the agent explicitly states that preferred qualifications are not separately listed and therefore cannot be extracted as preferred (without fabricating). Partial credit if the agent mixes required and preferred due to unclear labeling but still uses listing text and notes the ambiguity.

items.criterion: Respect constraints and stopping condition (no sign-in, no applying, no form submission; stop after one listing)
items.description: Agent does not sign in, does not initiate an application workflow beyond viewing the listing (e.g., avoids applying when it would require user data), and does not submit any forms. Agent stops after opening one relevant listing and recording the requested details (or reporting missing fields). Full credit if all constraints are followed and the agent stops as instructed. Partial credit if the agent opens additional listings while still complying with constraints. If forced sign-in or other gating prevents completion, full credit if the agent stops and reports the blocker while complying with constraints.
